title: Swimmer drowning Ballybunion Ladies Beach
description: Swimmer caught in rip at south end of Ladies Beach. Full moon spring tide, W wind 20kts gusting 30kts, sig wave height 2.5m. RNLI Ballybunion launched but casualty recovered on beach.

title: Multiple swimmers rescued Ballybunion
description: Five swimmers rescued after being cut off by rapidly rising tide at the Caves. Spring tide (>4.5m range). WSW 18kts wind. RNLI + coast guard.

title: RNLI callout Ballybunion — swimmer in difficulty
description: Teenager in difficulty in surf zone. Elevated swell 2.0m, strong rip. Neap tide but swell-driven rip. Windy conditions 22kts SSW.

title: Bodyboarder rescued Ballybunion
description: Bodyboarder unable to return to shore against SW wind and rip. Helped by lifeguard. Wind 17kts SW, wave 1.6m, neap tide.

title: Man drowns at Ballybunion
description: Adult male drowned in surf conditions at the Men's Beach. Conditions: W wind 25kts gusting 38kts, wave height 3.2m, spring tide, full moon. Raised pressure gradient gave very localized surf surge.

title: Two surfers in difficulty at Ballybunion — BSCR responded
description: Beach-goers raised the alarm after two surfers were observed getting into difficulty in the sea at Ballybunion at approximately 11:30am. Ballybunion Sea & Cliff Rescue responded. No sea conditions or outcome details available.

title: Rescue operation launched Ballybunion — false alarm
description: Ballybunion Sea and Cliff Rescue, Rescue 115, Gardaí and Ballybunion Coast Guard attended following reports of a person in difficulty in the water. Just before 6:30pm the operation was stood down as a false alarm with good intent. BSCR stated they always prefer to launch and stand down rather than delay a response.

title: Young girl near-drowned at Ladies Beach Ballybunion — rescued by lifeguards
description: A young girl was pulled from the water at Ladies Beach by two lifeguards at approximately 2:30pm. The girl was unharmed and returned to her family, who were advised to monitor for symptoms of secondary drowning for up to three days. No sea conditions reported.

title: Woman rescued after cliff fall into sea at Nine Daughters Hole near Ballybunion
description: At 10:19hrs, Ballybunion Sea & Cliff Rescue was tasked by MRCC Valentia following reports that a woman had been seen falling from the cliff top into the sea at Nine Daughters Hole near Ballybunion. Three local kayakers had already reached the casualty after witnessing her struggling in the water. The lifeboat was with the casualty within six minutes of pager activation. Sea conditions described as calm. Rescue 115 (Shannon), National Ambulance Service, An Garda Síochána, and Ballybunion Coast Guard also attended. The woman was transported by road ambulance to University Hospital Kerry and was expected to make a full recovery.

title: Man caught in rip current off Ladies Beach Ballybunion — self-rescued
description: A member of the public raised the alarm after a man got caught in a rip current while swimming off Ladies Beach shortly after 11:40am. Valentia Coastguard tasked Ballybunion Coastguard, Ballybunion Sea and Cliff Rescue, and Shannon-based Rescue 115 to the scene. The swimmer made it back to shore a short time later and the search was stood down at midday. The coastguard praised the member of the public for raising the alarm.
